tweets.text: If you're the person who wakes up when a car door closes outside, the fix probably isn't a regular fan — it's the difference between sound that masks noise and sound that just adds more noise.

3 sound machines for light sleepers, compared:
🌀 Mechanical fan (Marpac Dohm) — real fan sound, zero looping, $45-60
🔊 Digital white noise (LectroFan) — more tone variety, still no loop, $30-50
🌅 Smart sound + light (Hatch Restore) — adds a sunrise alarm, $100-170

Before: lying awake at 2am because a car door, a creaky floor, or a partner rolling over kept snapping you out of it.
After: one steady, predictable sound your brain learns to tune out instead of react to. That's the whole mechanism — no magic involved.
